result.notes_for_verifier: The six browser tests in e2e/test_m6b_section_layout.py import the mock helpers (open_page, answer, grant_item and the fixtures) from test_m6b_admin. Each one opens its page at 1366 by 860, locates the region by role region with its exact name, and checks two things. The heading's height must be under twice its font size. Every other direct child of the region must start within 1 px of the heading's left edge, at or below the heading's bottom edge (measured with getBoundingClientRect). Grants is covered with rows and in its error state. The audit test checks both "Chain verification" and "Filter the audit log". The Node test only reads the e2e file source, so it checks that the six region names and the criterion tag are present and does not measure layout. Browser tests are tagged with the criterion only, so the Node test is the only one the gate traces. I changed no production code.
result.summary: I added a browser test file for the Section layout of the six admin regions, plus a small Node test that guards it. The Node gate passes (2669 pass, 0 fail). I could not run the browser tests here because the gate only runs Node, so they are unrun.
